name: mainline_objective_contrast_exposure_v1
objective: Use frozen source forecasts and target histories to locate objective-difference misranking and its terminal exposure, without using conservative risk errors as an objective repair.
scope: Retain all24 overlapping source cases with native/FULL/AFTER/POINT and their frozen initial10/final13 forecasts. Use the original unused-raw scoring labels and response scales.

Compare objective-difference error and ordering across the registered held policies, reporting observed-observed, observed-unobserved and unobserved-unobserved pairs separately. Aggregate within a source case before family summaries; pairs and overlapping folds are not independent tasks.

Keep all24 d1000 geometries,72 role registrations,71 completed posterior records,48 saved same-history native views and all9 terminal references. Preserve POINT3018 failure and Queue3009 undefined quality baseline.

For each existing history, compare saved objective forecasts, actually observed raw objective differences, observation counts and saved episode-noise predictions. Join only existing cached truth for retrospective scoring, not model selection.

Connect objective order to original risk eligibility, actual transformed shortlist, paired objective comparisons, safety attempts and certified deployment. Count a changed unverified/fallback record separately from changed certified deployment.

Keep Queue3016 as a focal negative alongside all cases and role/native positives and negatives. FULL/AFTER/native all prefer18 over53 in objective mean there; native and AFTER exclude truly feasible18, so their success does not validate their objective ranking.
Only identical ordered raw histories support terminal mechanism attribution. Later divergent-history differences remain descriptive. No cross-history posterior replay.

Use only saved uncertainty information. Missing cross-policy objective covariance remains unknown; never substitute the sum of marginal variances for posterior difference variance. Low source repeat counts do not support exact pairwise confidence claims.
decision: Do not adopt a risk or terminal patch. First determine whether source-supported objective-difference errors or comparison exposure supply a common minimal correction; opened target cases are diagnostic evidence, not independent validation.
cost: Record read-only analysis CPU, all attempts and prior paid-account references. No rerun of already validated terminal reconstruction.
